thread:
tara: CI red — hosted integration tests are failing on main. Tests hitting Hosted API return auth errors and streaming hangs. tool-calling/schema tests also flaky. Can someone triage? https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/98765 :warning:
ci-bot: Build 98765 failed (tests). See: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/98765 

mike: looking. grabbing logs now. which tests are failing specifically?

tara: failures at least: test_auth_refresh_flow, test_streaming_tool_calling_timeout, test_schema_validation_mismatch. Short logs pasted below.

mike: quick copy of failing request (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream
< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"token expired"}
```

devon: I touched token refresh logic in PR #4321 yesterday (small change to backoff/refresh). I'll bisect. If this is correct I can revert or patch.

ana: heads up — we rotated staging KMS keys last night as part of infra cleanup. tests should use the test SA key but there was a migration that flipped a flag. possible sting. @ana can you check CI secret pointing to staging key?

ana: confirmed — the CI secret HOSTED_TEST_KEY was accidentally updated to the staging KMS alias in the deployment script. That alias points to a key with a different rotation schedule. I'm rolling back the alias to the test key now.

mike: thanks. I'll requeue the build after the rollback. in parallel devon, please run git bisect. command I used locally to narrow: `git bisect start && git bisect bad HEAD && git bisect good origin/main~10` and then `pytest tests/integration/test_streaming.py::test_streaming_tool_calling_timeout -q`

devon: bisect in progress. first few commits blame PR 4321 as suspected.

sre-bot: Metric alert: auth.401.rate increased 12x in hosted-us-west-2 over the last 10m.

mike: re-run kicked off (build 98766). Fingers crossed. Also noticed test_schema_validation_mismatch shows payload envelope "tool_result" vs expected "toolResponse" — sounds like a contract change.

ana: rollback done. pointing CI to static test key until we have the rotation change validated.

ci-bot: Build 98766 triggered (rerun). Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/98766

mike: partial green. auth tests now passing, streaming still flaky (hang at handshake), schema test still failing. logs: streaming hung during chunked response read, nothing in runtime logs indicating dropped connection.

devon: digging into streaming hang. I see one change in PR 4320/4321 where we tightened websocket keepalive and **also** changed default chunk timeout from 15s -> 5s for streaming harness. Tests may time out waiting for slower backend. I'll prepare a small patch to restore 15s in test harness.

ana: schema mismatch — PR 4318 changed tool-calling envelope to the new shape. Tests expect old envelope. Either update tests or publish a compatibility shim. Which do we prefer?

tara: short-term: make tests accept both shapes (wider matcher) to unflake CI. Longer: coordinate with eng-runtime to finalize envelope and announce to teams. I've created issue #987 and added eng-runtime + devex.

devon: pushed bisect revert of the token refresh change to branch `fix/ci-token-revert` (PR open). Also pushed test-harness timeout revert to `fix/stream-timeout`.

mike: merged the timeout revert into test branch and re-ran. Build 98767 in progress.

ci-bot: Build 98767 finished. Result: all integration tests passed except test_schema_validation_mismatch.

mike: schema test failing still — patch incoming to accept both envelopes. small change in tests is low risk.

ana: I'll coordinate a follow-up to ensure CI uses explicit test key and add a pre-flight check that the key's rotation window is > 30d.

tara: action items: devon finalize/revert PR for token refresh (done -> monitor), mike update schema matcher in tests (in progress), ana (naming) ensure CI secrets pinned + add preflight, tara schedule 30m postmortem tomorrow 11:00 in eng-oncall to formalize test harness expectations.

devon: quick note — if folks need to reproduce locally: `pytest tests/integration -k streaming -q` then `export HOSTED_TEST_KEY=...` and run with `REDWOOD_HOSTED_API=https://hosted.redwood.ai` to hit hosted.

mike: updated tests to accept both envelopes and pushed branch `ci/schema-flex`. rerunning build 98768.

ci-bot: Build 98768 finished. All integration tests passed.

tara: :tada: thanks team. We'll leave the reverted token change in place until we have a tested rollout plan for rotation/backoff. Follow-up notes in #987. Closing thread but keeping watch on auth 401 alert for next 24h. :eyes:

sre-bot: Continued monitoring enabled for auth.401.rate. Notify if >5x baseline.

mike: I'll keep an eye and add slack alert to the incident channel if it spikes again.
